info.name: ElderCare Connect API
info.description:
Functional, security and end-to-end integration tests for the ElderCare Connect API Gateway.
Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner or `newman run`). Folder '0. Auth' must run first.

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set("refreshToken", j.refresh_token); // the old one is spent now
pm.test("Schema: id, vitals, severity", () => { pm.expect(c.id).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(c.vitals.systolic).to.eql(126); });
pm.test("No anomalies for normal vitals", () => pm.expect(c.severity).to.eql("none"));
pm.test("201 first time, 200 duplicate on replay", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 201]));
pm.test("Has patient, trends, checkins", () => { pm.expect(j.patient.id).to.eql("P-1001"); pm.expect(j.trends).to.have.property("bloodPressure"); pm.expect(j.checkins).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("Alert id + notifications", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.alertId).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.notifications).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("200 when OPENWEATHER_API_KEY set, 503 when not configured", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 503]));

pm.test("Sorted by priority (P1 first), then score desc", () => { for (let i = 1; i < items.length; i++) { const a = items[i-1], b = items[i]; pm.expect(a.priority <= b.priority).to.be.true; if (a.priority === b.priority) pm.expect(a.scores.total >= b.scores.total).to.be.true; } });

item.name: 2. Family alert fired (poll up to 2 s)

exec: setTimeout(() => {}, 1200); // give the asynchronous saga time to propagate
const hit = pm.response.json().notifications.find(n => n.metadata && n.metadata.checkinId === id);
pm.test("Family Alert service raised an alert for this check-in", () => pm.expect(hit, "alert for checkin " + id).to.exist);
pm.test("SMS queued/sent to subscribers", () => pm.expect(hit.delivery.some(d => d.channel === "sms")).to.be.true);
pm.test("Triage item exists with P1/P2 priority", () => { pm.expect(item).to.exist; pm.expect(item.priority).to.be.oneOf(["P1", "P2"]); });
console.log("End-to-end check-in -> alert -> clinic queue observed in", elapsed, "ms (includes 1.2 s wait)");
pm.test("End-to-end chain observed within 2.0 s of check-in + request overhead", () => pm.expect(elapsed).to.be.below(2000 + 1500));

item.name: 4. Nurse pulls legacy EMR history (SOAP adapter)

exec: pm.test("Status updated + follow-up logged", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.item.status).to.eql("in_review"); pm.expect(j.followUps.length).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: 6. v1.1 - Triage, visits, history, medicines, onboarding
Normal vitals de-escalate the case (vitals sync fix)
Queue: P-1001 health score is 0, not Urgent

exec: setTimeout(() => {}, 1500); // let the checkin.normal event reach the clinic service

pm.test("Case is still open for weather/other signals or gone", () => { if (item) { pm.expect(item.scores.health).to.eql(0); pm.expect(item.priority).to.not.eql("P1"); pm.expect(item.category).to.be.oneOf(["high","watch","routine"]); } });
if (item) pm.collectionVariables.set("v11ItemId", item.id); else pm.collectionVariables.set("v11ItemId", pm.collectionVariables.get("e2eItemId"));
pm.test("422 visit_details_required or 404 if case closed", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([422, 404]));

item.name: Schedule visit - date, time, destination, location (201)

exec: const d = new Date(Date.now() + 8*3600e3 + 86400e3); pm.collectionVariables.set("visitDate", d.toISOString().slice(0,10));

item.name: Complete visit + resolve case (Recent Visits trigger)

exec: pm.test("Visit completed, case resolved", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.visit.status).to.eql("completed"); pm.expect(j.item.status).to.eql("resolved"); });

pm.test("Resolved case with visit + notes", () => { const c = pm.response.json().cases.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("v11ItemId")); pm.expect(c).to.exist; pm.expect(c.resolutionNotes).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(c.visits).to.not.be.empty; });
pm.test("Profile fields", () => { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.id).to.eql("P-1001"); pm.expect(p).to.have.property("addressLine"); });
pm.test("Medicines + today schedule", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.medications).to.not.be.empty; pm.expect(j.todaySchedule).to.be.an("array"); });

item.name: Reuse of spent token #1 -> session revoked (400)
Session A access token is dead (401)

exec: pm.test("active kid + rotation info, no key material", () => { pm.expect(j.access.activeKid).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.rotation.intervalDays).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(j)).to.not.include("secret"); });
// Signs the body like TextBee does (HMAC-SHA256 hex in X-Signature) when textbeeSecret is set.
if (secret) pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: "X-Signature", value: CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(raw, secret).toString(CryptoJS.enc.Hex) });
pm.test("unsigned webhook rejected (set textbeeSecret to the gateway's TEXTBEE_WEBHOOK_SECRET)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

10. Batch 5.1 - Check-in status flow (Received -> Awaiting review -> Reviewed -> Action recorded)
Caregiver submits a check-in with measuring devices -> 201, status received
Caregiver sees it awaiting review once it reached the clinic queue

exec: pm.test("log: received then awaiting_review, with timestamps", () => {
// the outbox relay moves it to awaiting_review after the broker confirms (normally < 1 s)

pm.test("contains the new check-in with the patient name", () => { const c = j.checkins.find((x) => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("statusCheckinId")); pm.expect(c).to.be.ok; pm.expect(c.patientName).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: Family cannot see the review queue -> 403
Family sees the full status timeline

exec: pm.test("action_recorded with 4 steps", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.checkin.status).to.eql("action_recorded"); pm.expect(j.statusLog).to.have.length(4); });

item.name: History shows the status on each check-in

exec: pm.test("every check-in has a status", () => pm.response.json().checkins.forEach((c) => pm.expect(["received","awaiting_review","reviewed","action_recorded"]).to.include(c.status)));

item.name: Missing readings recorded as a reason (not measured / no device / unknown) -> 201

exec: pm.test("reasons stored", () => pm.expect(c.vitalsMissing).to.eql({ bp: "no_device", spo2: "not_measured", bloodGlucose: "unknown" }));
pm.test("no zero stored for the missing BP", () => pm.expect(c.vitals.systolic).to.eql(null));

item.name: A value together with a missing reason -> 422
Admin cannot review a check-in -> 403 (nurses only)
Historical review list: older pending check-ins, never auto-reviewed

exec: pm.test("only pending, not archived", () => j.checkins.forEach((c) => { pm.expect(c.archived).to.eql(null); pm.expect(["received", "awaiting_review"]).to.include(c.status); }));

item.name: Nurse archives pending demo check-ins (status unchanged) -> 200
Archived list holds demo records only, none reviewed

exec: pm.test("demo only, still pending", () => pm.response.json().checkins.forEach((c) => { pm.expect(c.dataOrigin).to.eql("demo"); pm.expect(c.review).to.eql(null); }));
